constraint_review: Load about 60 kg: met - concept carries 60 kg parcel plus tare with spine SF 9.02, brake hold 98.9 Nm sized to 198 Nm, and 226 N lever heave; Operated by one person: met - closed-loop handles at 90-110 cm, 226 N heave under 350 N one-step limit, 7.38 kg tare liftable, deadman fail-safe brake and strap retention for single-operator control.
feedback: Concept works physically and is buildable - accept. Load path toe->twin spine->tri-star axle is continuous, energy per 0.2 m riser 141 J matches mgh ~ 67 kg*9.81*0.2=131 J plus friction, stair slope atan(200/250)=38.7 deg matches E58, Fslope=W*sin=706*0.625=441 N matches, brake T=W*0.14=98.9 Nm matches orbit model - arithmetic sound. Tare 0.475 kg/m for 30x2 mm Al tube re-derives correct from 2700 kg/m3*176 mm2, 2x1.2 m=1.14 kg plus wheels/toe to 7.38 kg plausible and liftable. 6061-T6 yield ~276 MPa /30.6 MPa=9.02 correct, pin 36.6 MPa << steel yield. Sizes sane vs person/door: handles hip height, folded 730x490x150 mm fits van door >1000 mm, toe 450x350 mm holds 40-60 cm parcels. Buildable from purchasable Al tube, solid-rubber wheels, steel pin, webbing strap, bike-type brake band with ordinary cut-drill-assemble. Meeting closed by consensus after 4 cycles with no open objections; all four roles voted ready citing same numbers - settled for concept stage. Deviations noticed: E58 at 25 deg lean gives margin -3.2 deg (tip-over) vs claimed 15 deg lean margin +6.8 deg in E60 - resolved only by strict 15 deg operating procedure, matters and leaves small 6.8 deg margin acknowledged in open question; Fslope 441 N exceeds assumed 250 N sustained limit, Flever 226 N meets 350 N heave limit - acceptable if stair climb is stepwise heaves not sustained pull, but must be noticed; brake 198 Nm vs 98.9 Nm calc is intentional SF~2, not a problem; folded thickness exactly at 150 mm limit is borderline for tolerance; prior-art AJ product rates 30 kg on stairs vs concept 60 kg on stairs at same tri-star principle - exceeds proven rating and relies on analysis. Key claims with no direct evidence/source: unfold <30 s (only generic E46 search), wipe-clean/solid-tyre durability, brake friction on worn/wet nosing, exact CG for tip 21.8 deg, bending moment arm for 30.6 MPa - all reasonable for concept but need detailed calc/sim/search later. Remaining needs (not blocking): compute lever geometry for 226 N, CG-based tip model over parcel sizes, wet friction brake hold, hinge tolerance and indicator reliability, van stow trial.
